The '''Commerce Guild trading station''' was established in the [[Bpfassh system/Legends|Bpfassh system]] by [[700 BBY]].

==History==
In that year, the station was infiltrated by [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] task force arrived and chased them down, but their [[Bpfasshi Dark Jedi leader|leader]] escaped after overriding a lockdown in its [[Docking Bay 16]].
